project_overview.title: DotFetch v1.2.0 - Authentication & Core Feature Enhancements
project_overview.description: This release focuses on delivering essential authentication mechanisms, improving request management workflows, and enhancing user experience with search, themes, and export capabilities. The scope is intentionally limited to ensure high code quality and maintainability.
project_overview.scope_statement: 12 feature tasks targeting authentication, core features, UI polish, and data export. Zero breaking changes to v1.1.0 API.
success_criteria: Logger system operational with isDevelopment flag
Backward compatibility verified with v1.1.0 collections

tasks: T201 - Basic Authentication (HTTP Basic Auth RFC 7617)
T202 - Bearer Token Authentication (OAuth 2.0 Bearer Tokens RFC 6750)
deliverables: Credential input UI with secure field handling
Storage of credentials in request objects
acceptance_criteria: Basic Auth produces RFC 7617 compliant headers
UI prevents accidental credential exposure in logs

phase_2_core_features.focus: Core request and history management enhancements
deliverables: Syntax highlighting engine for JSON responses
Full-text search with date range filtering
acceptance_criteria: JSON responses display with proper color coding

phase_3_refinement.focus: UI polish, export capabilities, and quality assurance
deliverables: Dark theme toggle with system preference detection
Enhanced error messaging with contextual help
acceptance_criteria: Size warnings trigger at 1MB and 5MB thresholds
Exported JSON is valid and importable

phase_4_testing.focus: Integration testing, quality assurance, and documentation

T201.title: Basic Authentication Implementation
T201.description: Implement HTTP Basic Authentication (RFC 7617) support with automatic Base64 encoding and Authorization header generation.
acceptance_criteria: Username and password input fields in request builder
Automatic encoding of credentials to Base64

technical_specifications.security_notes: Credentials transmitted only via HTTPS. Use logger system to prevent credential exposure.

definition_of_done: Manual testing on HTTP and HTTPS endpoints
No security warnings in code review

T202.title: Bearer Token Authentication Implementation
T202.description: Implement OAuth 2.0 Bearer Token support (RFC 6750) with automatic header formatting.
acceptance_criteria: Token input field in request builder

T203.title: JSON Response Syntax Highlighting
T203.description: Implement syntax highlighting for JSON responses with color coding and bracket matching.
acceptance_criteria: JSON objects display with syntax colors
Proper handling of null, boolean, and numeric types
Performance acceptable for responses up to 10MB

technical_specifications.approach: CSS-based highlighting with semantic HTML markup
technical_specifications.alternative_approach: Consider Prism.js or highlight.js for advanced features
technical_specifications.browser_compatibility: All modern browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)

definition_of_done: No XSS vulnerabilities in HTML generation

T204.title: Request Templates System
T204.description: Implement request templates functionality allowing users to save and reuse request patterns.
acceptance_criteria: Quick-load templates into current request form
Template metadata includes creation date and usage count
Templates support all request attributes (method, headers, body, auth)

ui_changes: Add 'Save as Template' button in request builder

T205.title: Automatic Request Retry with Backoff
T205.description: Implement automatic request retry logic with exponential backoff for transient network failures.
acceptance_criteria: Automatic retry on specific error codes: ECONNREFUSED, ENOTFOUND, ETIMEDOUT

technical_specifications.user_communication: Show 'Retry attempt X of Y' in UI

definition_of_done: No regression in normal request flow

T206.title: History Search and Filtering
T206.description: Implement search and filtering capabilities for request history with real-time updates.
acceptance_criteria: Search field filters history by URL, method, and status code
Date range filter for history entries
Search results update in real-time as user types
Clear filter button to reset search

T207.title: Request Annotations (Notes/Comments)
T207.description: Add optional annotation field for request documentation and context.
acceptance_criteria: Textarea field for request notes in request builder
Notes visible in request history on hover

T208.title: Response Payload Size Warnings
T208.description: Display warnings for large response payloads to alert users of potential performance issues.
acceptance_criteria: No blocking - user can still view response

T209.title: Dark Theme Support
T209.description: Implement dark theme with automatic detection of system preference.
acceptance_criteria: Automatic detection of system dark mode preference
All UI components properly styled for both themes

themes: Light - follows VS Code light theme
Dark - follows VS Code dark theme
technical_specifications.accessibility: Sufficient color contrast for WCAG AA compliance

T210.title: Enhanced Error Messages
T210.description: Improve error messages with actionable suggestions and helpful context.
acceptance_criteria: User-friendly error messages instead of raw technical errors
Suggestions for common issues (DNS, timeout, auth)

error_categories.ENOTFOUND: DNS resolution failed - Check domain spelling
error_categories.ECONNREFUSED: Connection refused - Check host and port

technical_specifications.logger_integration: Log raw errors to logger system

definition_of_done: No sensitive data exposed in messages

T211.title: Customizable Keyboard Shortcuts
T211.description: Allow users to customize keyboard shortcuts for common operations.
acceptance_criteria: Settings panel shows all available shortcuts
Users can modify shortcut key combinations

T212.title: Collection Export to JSON
T212.description: Enable exporting request collections as portable JSON files for backup and sharing.
acceptance_criteria: Exported JSON includes all requests and metadata
Exported JSON is valid and can be re-imported

component_changes.media_index_html: Add auth fields, settings controls, search/filter UI, export buttons
component_changes.media_script_js: Implement auth logic, template system, retry loop, search filtering, export functionality
component_changes.media_styles_css: Theme variables, dark mode styles, new UI component styling
component_changes.src_extension_ts: Retry implementation, enhanced error handling, size warning logic
component_changes.src_logger_ts: Enhanced logging for retry attempts and auth operations

external_dependencies: No new npm packages - use existing Axios and VS Code APIs
technical_architecture.backward_compatibility: Full backward compatibility with v1.1.0 collections and settings

testing_strategy: Manual functional testing for each feature
Performance testing on large history datasets
code_review_checklist: No console.log - use logger system only
Security review for auth token handling

must_have: Logger system operational with isDevelopment flag
Complete CHANGELOG with all features documented

low_risk: Bearer token implementation - simple header formatting
Response size warnings - leverages existing size calculation
medium_risk: Retry logic - potential for unintended retries if error detection too broad
JSON highlighting - performance impact on large responses
Keyboard shortcut customization - potential conflict issues
mitigation_strategies: Thorough testing of error detection patterns
